title: Tailwind v4 Setup / Migration Plan
description: A structured plan for a Tailwind v4 setup or v3-to-v4 migration, so this skill's anti-patterns and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/tailwind_v4_audit.mjs.

importModel.description: The CSS entry point: v4's single `@import "tailwindcss"` vs the v3 `@tailwind base/components/utilities` directives.

configFileDeleted.description: True if tailwind.config.js is deleted (or absent from a fresh project) -- v4 ignores it.

dynamicClassStrategy.description: How dynamic class names are handled: a const map of literal classes, a CSS-variable indirection, raw template literals (invisible to Oxide), or no dynamic classes.

workspaceDepsWithClasses.description: True if any workspace/monorepo dependency (e.g. a shared @my-org/ui package) contains Tailwind class strings.

sourceGlobsDeclared.description: True if every such workspace dep has an @source glob (relative to the CSS file) so Oxide scans it.

darkModeStrategy.description: The single dark-mode strategy in force. 'multiple' means strategies are mixed/scattered (a defect).

themeTokensInTheme.description: True if design tokens (colors, fonts, breakpoints, spacing) are defined in an @theme block, generating utilities and CSS variables from one source of truth.

v3PluginsPorted.description: True if every v3 plugin the project used has a v4-native replacement or was rewritten via @variant / @layer / custom utilities. Omit if no plugins were in use.

cssBundleKbGzipped.description: The gzipped size of the production CSS bundle in KB. Budget: <50KB for a typical app.
